### workspace push --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace push [--name WORKSPACE] [--json]

Push a workspace's branch to origin. A branch with no upstream is pushed with -u. When the
upstream has commits the branch lacks, the push uses --force-with-lease, but only if the
branch's own history once held all of them (a rebase replaced them); otherwise it is refused.
A pull request checkout (pr-N, from `start '#N'`) is pushed to the pull request's head branch
once gh confirms the pull request is open, comes from origin, and is at the commit fetched.
This changes origin for real. Exits 1 with an error when it refuses or the push fails; --json
prints the code (push_rejected, push_auth_failed, ...).

        --name NAME                  The workspace (default: the one the current directory is in)
        --json                       Print one JSON document (push is documented in docs/README.rebase.md)
    -h, --help                       Show this help

Examples:
  workspace push    # publish this branch to origin, setting its upstream the first time
  workspace push --name api.worktree-PROJ-123    # push another workspace's branch without changing directory
  workspace push --json    # after a rebase, for a script: forced with a lease only when the rebase replaced the upstream's commits; read outcome and forced
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace push --bogus
--- exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
invalid option: --bogus
--- end
